InVideo is a video generation and editing tool whose only recorded fact is a product page, with no litigation, MCP server, SEC, or patent data.

The company's site describes an editor and an editing agent called Agent Two that executes plain-language edits on a multitrack timeline, with user takeover at any frame. This positions InVideo as a consumer or prosumer video editing interface rather than an infrastructure or compute provider.

For AI scaling, the absence of compute, building, or power data means this record offers no evidence about grid constraints or hardware demand. It does not tell us model size, training cost, inference load, or energy use.
